figures.label: Figure 1

caption.text: Figure 1: A conceptual illustration highlighting characteristics of the quotient-space diffusion model for a distribution (shown in gray scale) on R² with SO(2) (i.e., rotational) symmetry. (Left) SDE sampling trajectories. Same color indicates the same starting point (round dot). The quotient-space diffusion moves only radially along rays emanating from the origin, representing the quotient space R²/SO(2) which traverses across equivalence classes (origin-centered concentric circles) without moving within an equivalence class (angular movement). The conventional diffusion model moves over the whole R² space, leading to jagged curves requiring subtler simulation. (Middle) Samples generated by the conventional equivariant diffusion model and (Right) by the quotient-space diffusion model. Both recover the same target distribution. The quotient-space diffusion also reduces learning difficulty (Eq. (11)) by allowing arbitrary model output in intra-equivalence-class movement (angular movement).

figures.label: Figure 3

caption.text: Figure 3: Illustration of denoising-model learning target using conventional equivariant diffusion, GeoDiff alignment, and AlphaFold 3 (AF3) alignment. (a) The example considers the structure distribution p(x₁) of a diatomic molecule, which concentrates on a single structure x⋆ up to a uniform random orientation. A xₜ sample is produced by scaling and adding noise to a x₁ sample. (b) For the given xₜ, equivariant diffusion training asks the model to match x₁ samples that distribute with a variance in orientation (the equivalent DoFs). The learning target E[x₁|xₜ] has an orientation correspondence to xₜ, and is not in the same shape as x⋆ (the bond is shorter). (c) Using GeoDiff alignment, all learning samples coincide with x⋆ in the orientation of xₜ (no variance in equivalent DoFs), so is the learning target E[Aₓₜ(x₁)|xₜ] (has orientation correspondence), which is different from E[x₁|xₜ] hence mismatches conventional diffusion samplers. (d) Using AlphaFold 3 (AF3) alignment, all learning samples coincide with x⋆ in the arbitrary orientation of model output (no variance in equivalent DoFs), so is the learning target, which hence does not ask the model to learn an orientation correspondence to xₜ, but also mismatches conventional diffusion samplers.

tables.label: Table 1

caption.text: Table 1: Mechanistic comparison among diffusion models for handling symmetry. Regarding leveraging the symmetry for easier training, we consider whether a method removes the need to learn to predict a target in the equivalent degrees of freedom (DoFs), and (if not) whether it removes the variance in the equivalent DoFs of target samples. Regarding generation validity, we consider whether the modified learning target has a compatible sampler that produces the correct target distribution. The denoising form Dθ of diffusion model is adopted. Ay (x) (Eq. (13)) aligns x towards y, and θ̄ treats θ as constant (i.e., stop-gradient). See Sec. 3.4 for details.

design_weaknesses: 11 列×约 6.7 pt，是全文最密表之一；caption 未写 FoldSeek v10、reference set 和 γ。
没有相对 vanilla 的差值列或 uncertainty；需回读 F.2.5 才能理解重算边界。
tables.reusable_pattern: 附录完整指标表承接主表筛选；caption 直接写软件版本、重算范围和行组条件，列数过高时拆分 quality/distribution 表。

caption.text: Table G.1.1: Training speed comparison on QM9.

tables.uncertainty: 单张 A100 的单点 iters/s；无重复、误差、计时窗口或失败计数。
tables.data_and_statistics: 唯一数据行为 training speed (iters/s)，四个方法为 Original diffusion 4.19、GeoDiff alignment 4.07、AF3 alignment 4.08、Quotient-space diffusion 4.10；精度两位小数。
tables.evidence_relation: Appendix G.1 的 O(N) complexity analysis 后调用该表，支持 projection/alignment 的实际额外训练成本较小；与 Figure G.1.1 的稳定性曲线互补，但不直接证明生成质量。
design_strengths: 一行一指标，四种 strategy 共用单位，无需 legend 即可读取。
表格极简、黑白矢量，适合作为 complexity 段落的快速检查。
design_weaknesses: hardware、batch、warm-up、计时窗口和重复信息不在表内；4.19 与 4.10 的小差异没有 dispersion。
caption 只写 QM9，未写 architecture 或 measurement protocol。
tables.reusable_pattern: 效率表保持一行一指标的极简形式，同时在 caption 固定硬件、batch、计时 protocol 和重复统计，避免过度解释单次速度。

cross_object_system.visual_narrative: Figure 1 建立 SO(2) quotient 直觉；Table 1 固定 DoF/variance/sampler 机制轴；Figure 2 将 manifold→quotient→horizontal lift 接到 Theorem 1/2 和 Eq. (7–10)；Figure 3 用 diatomic target counterexample 展开 alignment mismatch；Table 2/3 承担分子/蛋白 headline comparison；F.2.1/F.2.2 补配置和完整指标；G.1 与 G.3 补效率、稳定性和 epoch/NFE 诊断。
cross_object_system.caption_system: 所有 caption 使用 Figure/Table label:；主结果 caption 说明数据集、模型和 best/underline 规则，但将 metric 定义、sample count、50/400 steps、hardware 和 FoldSeek 版本留在正文。Figure 1/3 最接近自足，Figure 2、F.2.1 和 G.1.1 最简。
cross_object_system.table_header_system: Table 1 用机制列组；Table 2 用 Recall/Precision→Coverage/AMR→mean/median 三级表头；Table 3/F.2.2 用 metric→reference-set 二级表头；F.2.1 用 model-size 列；G.1.1 用 strategy 列。黑白表格以 bold/underline 或 ✓/✗ 表达决策。
cross_object_system.method_result_ablation_link: Figure 2 与 Eq. (6–10)/Theorems 建立方法接口，Table 1 与 Figure 3 解释 projection/alignment target 机制；Table 2/3 测量分子和蛋白结果；F.2.1/F.2.2 给配置和指标复核；G.1 验证速度/稳定性，G.3 验证训练 epoch 与采样 NFE 趋势。没有 P_x、h̃、projected-noise 的独立 component ablation。
cross_object_system.main_appendix_link: 正文 Table 2/3 指向 Appendix F 的 split、architecture、sampling 和 metric 细节；F.2.2 解释主文省略 diversity/novelty 的版本边界；Appendix G 承接 efficiency/other-setting 叙述。附录扩大完整性，但 G.3 只覆盖 GEOM-DRUGS/ET-Flow(SO(3))。
cross_object_system.typography_consistency: 正文 caption 和表格外围保持 Nimbus Roman/Computer Modern；嵌入 Figure 1/2/3 与 G.1/G.3 的图内字体不同。表体字号从 F.2.2 约 6.7 pt 到 F.2.1/G.1.1 约 10 pt，缺少统一 typography token。
cross_object_system.color_consistency: 表格的黑白规则稳定，但各 Figure 的方法颜色完全局部化；没有“quotient=同一颜色”的跨图语义，读者必须依赖每个 legend、面板标题或 caption 重建方法身份。

most_reusable_patterns: Figure 1 的“轨迹→样本→target 一致性”三面板，配合共享坐标、局部图例和线型/形状冗余。
Table 1 的固定 mechanism axes，将不同 symmetry treatment 放入同一接口。
Table 2/3 的多层表头，将 dataset/model regime、指标方向/单位和聚合方式对齐。
Figure G.3.1 的 paired budget panels，分别展示 training epoch 与 sampling NFE。
highest_value_objects: Figure 1：最强的 headline/method-interface 图，承接 quotient 几何直觉和 target-preservation claim。
Table 1 + Figure 3：最强的 theory/mechanism 组合，一个给离散机制矩阵，一个给同例 target counterexample。
Table 2：最完整的分子主比较，覆盖两个数据集、两种 ET-Flow 架构和 Recall/Precision 指标。
Table 3 + Table F.2.2：蛋白主结论与 FoldSeek v10 完整指标的配对证据。
Figure G.3.1：最有诊断价值的动态对象，展示 alignment degradation 和 NFE 趋势，但范围限于一个 molecular setting。
failure_patterns: 主要 Figure 是嵌入栅格，细字体、数学上下标和图例偏小；没有公开的本文绘图/LaTeX 源可恢复精确 rcParams、HEX、线宽或导出尺寸。
结果表主要给单点 mean/median 或单次配置，缺少 seed dispersion、样本分母和失败计数；bold/underline 不能替代 uncertainty。
caption 常把硬件、sampling steps、metric 定义、reference set 和版本 caveat 留在正文，F.2.2/G.1.1 尤其依赖邻近段落。
Figure 之间没有共享方法色彩；Figure 1/2/3 与 G.3.1 不能直接跨对象比较。
没有 projection、curvature correction、horizontal noise 的独立 component ablation；G.1/G.3 只能验证完整框架的稳定性、速度和预算趋势。
final_judgment.one_sentence_visual_strategy: 论文以 Figure 1–3 将 quotient-space 的几何接口和 alignment target 机制转成局部直觉，再用黑白多层表头承载分子/蛋白主结果与完整复核，最后用附录速度、稳定性和 epoch/NFE 曲线补充实现与预算证据，但没有统一跨对象的图形色彩或不确定性系统。
